This chapter follows the conserved state through the EOS[^rg-ba9e60e5ab2e] and the last stage's phase solve. It
defines the stored rows and their maps to the primitive state, including anomaly storage, and describes the five
EOS types, their energy conventions and the identities the floors and the transport rely on. Two of the types,
`ideal-gas` and `ideal-moist`, may be captured in a CUDA[^rg-6f633b2ccc44] graph; the other three always run eager
(@sec-ch02-other-eos). Floors belong to @sec-ch08; rejection and condensate repair belong to @sec-ch08.

Switch-combination coverage is recorded in @sec-ch12-matrix.

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| conservation laws and variables | `anomaly` | always; anomaly off | transport-dependent | `test_anomaly_storage` |
| EOS interface | `type`[^rg-05f4e1b392d6] | `moist-mixture` | not applicable | `test_hydro_options` |
| ideal gas | `ideal-gas` | unselected | exact algebra | `test_eos` (zero offset) |
| ideal moist | `ideal-moist` | unselected | exact algebra | `test_eos_temp2inteng` |
| other types and capture | `type` | not captured | not applicable | `test_eos`, `test_aneos_gamma` |
| moist mixture | `moist-mixture` | the default type | iterative tolerance | `test_eos` (moist mixture) |
| ANEOS | `aneos` | unselected | external | `test_aneos_gamma` (stand-in) |
| shallow water | `shallow-water` | unselected | exact algebra | examples, `FULL_TESTS` only |
| consistency | none | required | identity | `test_eos_temp2inteng` |
| saturation | `uv-solver`[^rg-82c623ddbaeb] | `auto` | iterative tolerance | `test_check_redo_saturation` |
